gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-todhr: Almendra Display has ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, and it carries the page with a low-modulation flourish. Noto Serif Todhri takes the quieter job, with curves whose thinnest points still hold real weight.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-toto: Almendra Display sets a literary, ornate tone. Noto Serif Toto brings a hulking lowercase, like thick chalk pressed hard, and that heft against the heading's open, storybook shapes is the strongest thing about this pair.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-vithk: Ornate letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its storybook charm. Noto Serif Vithkuqi follows with big round lowercase bowls and a mellow thick-thin difference, so the text feels settled under the flourish.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-serif-yezid: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display wants room to show off its pronounced x-height. And Noto Serif Yezidi, a classic serif with gently tapered strokes, packs its words into solid blocks that would swallow a heading shrunk too small.
gen-almendra-display-gf-odor-mean-chey:
Almendra Display keeps its letters open and ornate.

Odor Mean Chey, a text serif with squeezed a, e and s and tall rounded forms, feels dignified and editorial beside it, a tight-lipped companion to such an open-mouthed heading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-pt-serif-caption: PT Serif Caption stands tall, its x-height noticeable at a glance, with thinner joins where curves meet stems. And its literary, editorial classic serif manner matches Almendra Display's ornate shapes, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-suez-one:
Suez One looks bookish and refined.

Its tall-bowled e and a, each with a thin channel into the counter, sit beneath Almendra Display's wide-open ornate letters, so the page moves from flourish to a denser, closed-in serif.
gen-almendra-display-lora: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. Lora, a classic serif with modest hairline thinning and a broad, welcoming c, would keep a longer passage feeling bookish and easy going.
gen-almendra-display-merriweather: Cozy and stocky, Merriweather runs a middle band so tall the line looks sturdy. Merriweather's soft thick-thin difference meets Almendra Display's ornate, literary letters, and that snug-versus-flourished tension is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-amatic-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Scribbled, tall and a bit wild, Amatic SC draws every stroke like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line. Bespoke Sans is the sharp, refined foil, with generous space between curve ends and stem, and that rustic-versus-crisp gap is the pair's strongest quality.
